name: fmp_market_risk_premium
description:
Equity market risk premium by country from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP), with country risk premium, in percent.
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/market-risk-premium as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): none.
Feed a premium into calc_capm or calc_wacc.
Needs an FMP API key (config fmp.api.key, env FMP_API_KEY); without one it returns a demo placeholder naming the endpoint instead of data.
Example: {}
